measurement_note: Size is n * 2^n, the bitmask-state transition scale after O(n^3) line-mask precomputation. Points lie on y = x^2, so no line covers more than two and the answer is ceil(n/2). Pair-line mask DP considers at most n transitions per covered mask; a correct partition DP that enumerates every remaining collinear subset performs 3^n subset transitions, finishes all legal tiers, and fails only by scaling.
